'''Ayako Shiraishi''' (Japanese: '''白石文子''' ''Shiraishi Ayako'') was a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Shiraishi was born on April 13, 1963 in {{wp|Ōita Prefecture|Ōita}}, {{wp|Japan}}. She started work during {{aniseries|OS}} in ''[[EP002|Pokémon Emergency!]]'' as [[Nurse Joy]]. She retired in 2002, passing the role on to [[Yuriko Yamaguchi]]. Her last episode was [[EP229]].
